Something to note. The run in late Jan/early Feb saw the ATH tested but rejected, and then a 2-month long consolidation that was pretty flat and predictable.

Look even further to Dec, and same thing. ATH retest, and then consolidation sideways.

Til then, TTM suggests channel trend on daily is strong. As always, look to $BTC and $ETH as industry canaries.
